reason: This plugin’s user-facing purpose is to act as an ACP server frontend for DeepSeek Harness, letting ACP-compatible clients drive dsh coding-agent sessions via stdio or HTTP+SSE. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows it focuses on session orchestration (start, prompt, resume, close), streaming interaction, tool/permission handling, and optional host-plane observability endpoints for jobs/goals/skills/tree rather than standalone coding or UI features.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 服务器插件，可通过 stdio 或 HTTP/SSE 让支持 ACP 的客户端连接并驱动 dsh 代理会话，支持会话交互、会话管理与相关工具调用。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness ACP server plugin that lets ACP-compatible clients connect via stdio or HTTP/SSE to run and manage dsh agent sessions with interactive prompts and tool-driven workflow events.

capabilities: ACP JSON-RPC session orchestration and streaming conversation handling
Tool-call and permission-dialog mediation between client and dsh services
Local and remote transport for session control (stdio and HTTP+SSE)
Read-only host-plane introspection for sessions/jobs/goals/skills/agent tree

reasons.code: README documents supported ACP methods including session creation, prompt streaming, permission requests, cancellation, close, list/resume/load, and mode switching, showing it manages interactive agent sessions.
README documents vendor extension methods under dsh/* for sessions, jobs, goals, skills, and agents, plus watch/unwatch and changed notifications, indicating orchestration/state-exposure behavior.

Package manifest defines the executable entrypoint `dsh-acp-server` and marks the package as a dsh bundle via `dsh.bundle.patch`, confirming it is intended as an installable integration plugin for DSH profiles.
